strategy_notes: Tomorrow all teams will trade only on high‑conviction setups with clear catalyst confirmation and price above VWAP. Keep the portfolio net‑long but enforce a minimum 75% invested rule while respecting tighter position limits. Prioritize sectors that showed profitability (Defense, Financials, Consumer) and sharply curtail Space and Entertainment activity until win rates improve.

team_focus.defense: Add AVAV, SAIC and HII as suggested; only open new buys with conviction >=4 and price > VWAP; use 50% scale‑out at 1R and tighten stop‑loss to 1.5% ATR.
team_focus.space: Implement a 24‑hour pause on new long entries; only short after 30‑minute VWAP confirmation and ATR‑based stops; aim to reduce trade count to ≤6 per day.
team_focus.entertainment: Limit trades to max 4 per day; only add stocks with strong short‑term momentum and conviction >=4; tighten stops to 2% and avoid earnings‑day entries.
team_focus.tech: Avoid new positions in high‑volatility earnings windows; require RSI<70 and price above VWAP; set stops at 1.5% ATR and reduce trade frequency to ≤8.
team_focus.consumer: Maintain current exposure; short TSLA only if price stays below VWAP for 15 min; long AMZN only after a bounce above VWAP; keep trade count ≤5.
team_focus.financials: Continue current strategy but enforce stop‑loss on all new trades; ensure trailing stops are active; limit new entries to high‑conviction (>=4) opportunities.
team_focus.healthcare: Cut new long entries; only trade after a confirmed catalyst and price above VWAP; use ATR‑based stops of at least 2%.

go_live_assessment.reason: Paper‑trading period is only 3 days (needs 60) and risk‑budget constraints are still causing high block rates; further validation required.

decision_log: Tightened position and daily loss limits, raised conviction threshold, and re‑allocated capital toward winning teams to protect equity after a broadly negative day.
